list_status: Rockstar and PlayStation had NOT published an official trophy list when this guide was built (19 Nov 2026). The 55 names, descriptions and grades below are the list reported in agreement by multiple outlets on 18 Nov 2026; the PSNProfiles community has called the circulating named list 'probably fake' and only the count of 55 traces to a dataminer claim. Treat every name, grade and guide step here as REPORTED, not confirmed — verify against your console's trophy list at launch. Sources are cited per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is nothing to chase directly here: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Work the roadmap in order, keep the 100% gold for last, and the platinum arrives with it. Early estimates put the whole road at roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It unlocks naturally as the story starts, so just follow the on-screen objectives and do not rush past the tutorial prompts.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy reported missable, and that spot is gone once the chapter ends. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter first.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Both protagonists are playable from here, which opens most of the rest of the list — side strands, activities and collectibles all become reachable, so start sweeping them up between story missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — the game is reported to have no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back if you miss something inside it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. By now the map should be mostly open: use the quiet stretches between story missions to clear one-shot trophies and stranger strands while you are already in the area.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from before it: the ending involves choices, and at least one other trophy (Actions Speak Louder) is tied to choices made, so a pre-finale save lets you revisit the ending without replaying the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the story, so there is nothing extra to find — just finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to be long and checkpointed, so play it through in one sitting and let the checkpoints carry you.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story mission trophies like this one unlock by finishing the mission, so no special setup is needed — just reach it in the story and complete it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. If a mission ever feels like it hides an optional objective, finish the mission first — the trophy is for completion, and optional goals belong to the 100% checklist, not to this trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Learn the airport layout while you are here: the one-shot trophy Catch Me If You Can also happens at VCIA, so note the exits and the runway for later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies, so once it pops your story set is nearly done — only the finale gold remains.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist as your master list. This is the hardest trophy on the list and the longest grind: story, side strands, collectibles, activities and challenges all feed into it. Save it for last, then work the checklist top to bottom until it hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, air time and slides while driving. Stunts count across free roam, so fold them into everyday travel between objectives instead of grinding them in one place, and use ramps and long straights to chain them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling and the rest. One try each is enough, so sample everything early and tick this off while exploring.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each drill's target pattern first, then chase gold one challenge at a time — practice runs between missions keep it low-pressure, and steady aim beats fast trigger work.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Fly the course once just to learn its turns, then race to win — cutting corners costs you the race, so fly clean before you fly fast.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the race types on offer. Vary the vehicles and routes instead of repeating one race — each distinct win counts, so spread your wins around the map.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal's fishing challenge when it appears and out-fish him. If you lose, retry from a save — it is a challenge, not a one-time event, so keep your best bait and a steady hand for the rematch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game to the end. Pick the shortest game first and play it through — completion is what counts, not a high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand through to its last mission. Side strands unlock as you explore and progress the story, so check the map for Andy's marker after each chapter and clear his missions before moving on.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand through to its last mission. Like the other named strands, his missions appear over time — keep returning to his marker whenever it shows up on the map.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand through to its last mission. Clear side strands as they appear rather than leaving them all for after the story — some strands may close off as the story advances, so do not postpone them.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so sweep the map after each chapter and answer every stranger marker — eight finished strands is the target, not eight single missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand through to its last mission. Treat each named strand like a small story of its own: follow its missions in order and finish the strand before the finale where you can.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand through to its last mission. With Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, Tyrone is one of five named strands — finishing all five is most of the way toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every spot across Leonida — including Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, which disappears after that chapter, and the game is reported to have no mission replay. Do the balcony spot before Chapter 1 ends, meditate at every spot you find as you explore, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. If you miss the Chapter 1 spot, only an earlier save can save the run.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow his strand's clues to the animal's territory rather than roaming blind, track it carefully, and take the shot when it is clean — the trophy is for Bret's specific animal, not for hunting in general.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick them up as you travel instead of hunting them all at the end — and if the game lets you trade duplicates, use that to finish sets faster.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. It is a pure count grind, so do a few whenever you reach a new area instead of saving all 100 for the end — the counter climbs while you play the rest of the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. The in-game challenge list shows what is left, so work through the easiest ones first and let the harder ones fall as you play — 50 sounds like a lot, but challenges stack up across every activity.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: with your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape — all in one run. Save first. Plan the escape route before you raise the heat, use a fast car and alleys to break line of sight, and reload the save if the escape fails.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: with your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Save first, then plan a route between three close shops, hit them fast, and keep the heat on the whole time — if the wanted level drops, reload and try again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles. New models count when you find them, so drive or enter everything you see — parked cars, traffic, boats and bikes all count toward the total if they are new to you.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Save first, find a group of enemies close together, trigger Focus when they are clustered, and drop all five before the effect ends — one short means reloading the save.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT MOMENT: make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — slip out through the airport on foot or in a vehicle when the chance comes. Save before you try, scout the runway and exits during the VCIA Takedown mission, then make your break.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up heat with it — the description points at tank chaos, so expect a wanted-level brawl. Find a Rhino, climb in, and cause enough mayhem for the trophy to pop; the exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so check the cited guides at launch.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: rob a jewelry store without being detected. Save first, go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, take the goods and leave unseen — a single alarm fails the attempt, so reload the save and plan a cleaner route if you are spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT EACH TIME: rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car, a route away from the cops, and a clean exit matter more than the robbery itself. Each failed escape means redoing that vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: rob an armored truck and escape. Hit the truck, grab the cash, and break line of sight before the wanted level sticks — a planned escape route and a fast vehicle turn a heist into a clean getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the whole map is discovered. The trophy pops when the last area is found, so sweep the edges of the map — islands, swamps and back roads — and use the in-game map to spot the gaps you have not visited yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in the state. Each gang's turf is a separate stop, so work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which gang you have already hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: SECRET: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, so slow down and let the scene play.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT MOMENT: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Save first, pick a showroom, then drive out through the glass in style — the 'classic style' wording points at a big, loud exit, so commit to it once you start.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through. Play a full game at the alley — the follow-through is the point, so finish the game rather than quitting halfway.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: SECRET: a partnership with mass appeal. The description is cryptic by design — it points at doing a partner activity especially well. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so check the cited guides at launch before chasing it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: SECRET: choices made, for better or worse. This one is tied to a story choice, most likely around the finale. Keep a manual save from before the final mission so you can make the choice, and revisit the other option from the save if the trophy does not pop.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: SECRET: second time's the charm. The wording suggests failing once, then succeeding — try the linked encounter twice if the first attempt does not pop it. The exact encounter is still unconfirmed, so check the cited guides at launch.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: SECRET: what the hell just happened? An easter-egg style encounter — something strange out in Leonida. Follow the cited guides at launch for the trigger location, and keep an eye out for anything odd while exploring.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: bowl a group over with a melee drive-by. Line up a group of people on foot, swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, and knock them down like pins. Save first and pick a crowded spot where the group stands close together.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It accumulates over the whole game, so launder regularly instead of hoarding bills — every cleaned dollar counts toward the total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Big purchases count, so do not hold back on vehicles, clothes and gear — the total adds up naturally if you buy what you need instead of saving everything.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Check property listings as your money grows, and buy garages as they appear — owning them all is the trophy, and garages also give you somewhere to keep the 100 vehicles for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. It is a straight count, so keep registering vehicles as you collect them — ten registrations and the trophy pops.

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 + finale
roadmap.note: Play the story straight through. Make a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission — there is reportedly no mission replay.

roadmap.title: The one missable — save before Chapter 1 ends
roadmap.note: Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy reported missable: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 vanishes after the chapter. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.

roadmap.title: One-shot hunts — save before each
roadmap.note: Nine trophies must be done in a single attempt or a single story moment. Save first, attempt, reload if it fails. Never attempt one without a fresh save.

roadmap.title: Strangers & side strands
roadmap.note: Five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus stranger missions and Bret's hunt. Clear strands as they appear — do not leave them all for after the story.

roadmap.title: Activities, collectibles & the long grind
roadmap.note: The bulk of the list: 250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK spots, card sets, challenges, exploration and money. Fold these into normal play and mop up the counters last.

roadmap.title: 100% + Platinum
roadmap.note: Finish the in-game 100% checklist for A Long Road, and Vice Got a Price! pops with it. Roughly 200 hours all in, per early estimates.
